pack.summary: This week, students are exploring the life of Jesus and the 10 Commandments in Religion, reading 'The Boy Who Cried Wolf', and practicing three-letter blends in Spelling. The curriculum also covers soft c and g sounds, prefixes, and two-digit addition with and without regrouping in Math.
